title: Limit order book
tagline: fully on chain limit order book built on arbitrum stylus using a novel bitmap algorithm
description:
We are solving an open problem in DeFi- bringing limit order books on chain.

This was impossible on EVM given its limitations on computation and memory-till now. Arbitrum stylus allows you to write smart contracts in rust unlocking 10x more memory and throughput. We paired it with a novel bitmap based algorithm to make limit orders possible with EVM's 256 bit K-V storage trie structure.
how_its_made:
Tech stack

- Smart contract: rust
- Chain: arbitrum stylus
- Indexing: subtraphs (wip)

The smart contract builds up on a large number of innovations

- Bitmap tree: instead of a traditional tree structure to store orderbook nodes, we use EVM's 256 bit key value trie as the store. Encoding a full tree in EVM is wasteful as slot keys store temporary indices and every update forces large rebalancing writes. We structure data as a sparse matrix instead of a tree. The key hash encodes details like price and market ID while the state stores order state. 

- High througput allows us to market make dozens of orders across multiple markets in a single atomic call. We can beat Uniswap when it comes to gas and market making. Benchmarking is still wip.

- The smart contract code acts as the indexer and SDK. We code will be embedded inside a rust WASM subgraph and be used for indexing.
auto_summary: A Rust-based Arbitrum Stylus project implements an onchain limit order book using bitmap-structured state and supporting deployment scripts.
